# gpupaas_high_speed_storage (Resource)

A high-speed storage volume (`dev.envmgmt.io/v1` `Storage`) provisioned from a storage profile (SKU) that a platform administrator published, at project or workspace scope. Name it in the `hss_storage` argument of a bare-metal instance or the `shared_storage` argument of a virtual machine to attach it. Provisioning, a size change and deletion run asynchronously; the resource waits for them. The profile, datacenter, storage type, contract term and encryption settings are fixed at creation: changing one replaces the volume and its data. `size`, `access_policy` and `sharing` are applied to the existing volume.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A high-speed storage volume (a shared filesystem, for example) from a profile an administrator published.
# Instances attach it by name: `hss_storage` on a bare-metal instance, `shared_storage` on a virtual machine.
resource "gpupaas_high_speed_storage" "shared" {
  metadata = {
    name      = "training-data"
    project   = "system-catalog"
    workspace = "team-a"
  }

  spec = {
    type       = "weka-fs-profile" # the storage profile (SKU)
    size       = "500"             # in the unit the profile defines (GB unless it says GiB)
    datacenter = "dc-west"

    enable_encryption_at_rest = true
  }
}

# Mount details and credentials come back in status.output (sensitive, as strings).
output "filesystem_servers" {
  value     = gpupaas_high_speed_storage.shared.status.output["filesystem_servers"]
  sensitive = true
}

resource "gpupaas_bare_metal_instance" "trainer" {
  metadata = {
    name      = "trainer-1"
    project   = "system-catalog"
    workspace = "team-a"
  }

  spec = {
    type        = "bm-gpu-sku"
    image       = "ubuntu-24.04"
    ssh_key     = "admin-key"
    hss_storage = gpupaas_high_speed_storage.shared.metadata.name
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `metadata` (Attributes) Where the volume lives. Changing any of these replaces it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata))
- `spec` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec))

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) Time limits as durations such as `30m`. Defaults: create 30m, update 20m, delete 30m. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<project>/<workspace>/<name>`, or `<project>/<name>` for a project-scoped volume.
- `status` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status))

<a id="nestedatt--metadata"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metadata`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the volume.
- `project` (String) Project that owns the volume.

Optional:

- `workspace` (String) Workspace that owns the volume; omit for a project-scoped one. It must already exist.


<a id="nestedatt--spec"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec`

Required:

- `type` (String) Name of the high-speed storage profile (SKU) a platform administrator published, such as a shared filesystem or a block volume. Changing it replaces the volume.

Optional:

- `access_policy` (String) Access policy of the volume, as the profile defines it. A change is applied to the existing volume.
- `contract_term` (String) Contract term of the volume. Changing it replaces the volume.
- `datacenter` (String) Datacenter to provision in. Unset lets the platform choose. Changing it replaces the volume.
- `enable_encryption_at_rest` (Boolean) Encrypt the data at rest. Unset leaves it to the profile. Changing it replaces the volume.
- `enable_encryption_in_transit` (Boolean) Encrypt the data in transit. Unset leaves it to the profile. Changing it replaces the volume.
- `sharing` (Attributes) Resource sharing across workspaces or projects. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec--sharing))
- `size` (String) Requested capacity, a number in the unit the profile defines (GB unless the profile says GiB). Leave it unset for a profile with a fixed volume. A change is applied to the existing volume; if the platform does not support resizing this profile, the apply fails and the state shows the size it kept.
- `storage_type` (String) Classification of the volume: `block`, `file` or `object`. Unset lets the platform fill it from the profile. Changing it replaces the volume.

<a id="nestedatt--spec--sharing"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec.sharing`

Required:

- `share_mode` (String) Sharing mode (e.g. `ALL_WORKSPACES`, `SPECIFIC_WORKSPACES`, `SPECIFIC_PROJECTS`).

Optional:

- `projects` (Attributes List) Project sharing entries when `share_mode = SPECIFIC_PROJECTS`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec--sharing--projects))
- `workspaces` (List of String) Workspaces shared with when `share_mode = SPECIFIC_WORKSPACES`.

<a id="nestedatt--spec--sharing--projects"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec.sharing.projects`

Required:

- `name` (String)

Optional:

- `workspaces` (List of String)




<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String)
- `delete` (String)
- `update` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--status"></a>
### Nested Schema for `status`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) Last or in-flight operation: `deploy`, `update`, `destroy`, ...
- `output` (Map of String, Sensitive) What the platform reports about the provisioned volume, as strings: a filesystem's servers, mount username and credentials, the volume size in bytes; for an object store its bucket and S3 keys. The platform returns credentials in plain text, so the whole map is sensitive. Keys depend on the profile.
- `reason` (String)
- `status` (String) Platform status: `success` once the volume is provisioned, `failed`, `in_progress`, `deleting`, `delete_pending`, ...

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# <project>/<workspace>/<name>, or <project>/<name> for a project-scoped volume
terraform import gpupaas_high_speed_storage.shared system-catalog/team-a/training-data
```
